focus_areas: Anterior lateral margins of carapace for missing walking leg bases
Junction of claws and carapace for structural integrity
Texture fidelity of the shell surface
Symmetry and placement of eye stalks
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Please specifically audit the anterior lateral margins of the carapace adjacent to the chelipeds. Determine if the absence of walking leg bases constitutes a structural hallucination (missing parts) or if they are merely obscured by shadow/cropping. Additionally, verify if the connection points between the chelipeds and the main body show any signs of morphological blending or lack of distinct joint definition.
image_description: A close-up, frontal view of a Dungeness crab. The image prominently features the broad, reddish-brown carapace and two large chelipeds (claws) positioned in the foreground. The eyes are visible on stalks at the anterior margin. The framing is tight, focusing on the face and claws, with the lateral walking legs largely cropped out or obscured.
